newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GIESSEN WINS ORDER TO BUILD FERRY.
newsitem.headline: GIESSEN WINS ORDER TO BUILD FERRY.

text.p: Dutch shipyard Van der Giessen-De Noord NV said on Monday it had won an order to build a ferry for Sea Containers Ltd .
"The order involves an amount of about 75 million guilders," Van der Giessen said in a statement.

It added the order would not affect its 1997 profit forecast, as given earlier. In April, Van der Giessen said it expected a slightly positive result from ordinary operations this year. In 1996, the company suffered a net loss of 10.7 million guilders.
The ferry ordered by Sea Containers Ltd is to be used by its unit "Isle of Man Steam Packet Company Ltd" for its service between the Isle of Man and mainland Britain.
The ship will be delivered in the summer of 1998, Van der Giessen-De Noord said.
